text: Events API tracks user activity, updates profile fields, and triggers automations
quote: POST`/batch/events` Create Events Track user activity, update profile fields, and trigger automations.

text: Track custom events with detailed context, such as purchase amount and product or viewed URL
quote: Examples of events: `$purchase` with details like amount and product `$view` with the URL they visited

text: Batch API requests accept 1 to 1000 subscribers per call
quote: Request supports 1 to 1000 subscribers per post.

text: Bulk create or update subscribers via API without triggering automations
quote: POST`/batch/subscribers` Import Subscribers Bulk create or update subscribers without triggering automations.

text: Search subscribers, filtering by tags, segment, or date ranges on creation, update, last event, and unsubscribe
quote: Filter by tags, a segment, or by date ranges on creation, update, last event, and unsubscribe times.

text: Custom fields can be set through forms, API, flows, imports, or manually
quote: Fields can be set through multiple channels: Bento Forms... API... Flows... Imports... Manually

text: Tags can be added to people via flows, API, imports, or manually
quote: Tags can be added to people in several ways: Flows... API... Imports... Manually

text: Send transactional email such as password resets, receipts, login codes, and order confirmations
quote: Transactional email is for messages a person needs because of an action, request, or account state: password resets, receipts, login codes, account notices, and order confirmations.

text: Supports broadcasts, automated sequences, and transactional emails on one platform
quote: Emails are the messages you send to your audience. Bento handles three types: broadcasts for one-time campaigns, sequences for automated series, and transactional emails for individual notifications.

text: Official MCP server lets an AI assistant look up subscribers, create broadcasts, and track events conversationally
quote: The Bento MCP server gives your AI assistant direct access to your Bento account. It can look up subscribers, create broadcasts, track events, and more, all through natural conversation.

text: MCP server is hosted by Bento, so there is nothing to install, run, or update
quote: Bento hosts the MCP server at `https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp`. You point your AI app at that URL and add your API keys. There's nothing to install, run, or update.

text: Attribute sales and recurring revenue to the email or flow that preceded them
quote: Tie sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that came before.

text: Deduplicates purchase events so revenue isn't double-counted on page reloads or retries
quote: It lets Bento count revenue correctly without double-counting the same order if a thank you page reloads or your app retries the event.

text: Dedicated IP address options for high-volume senders
quote: Dedicated IP address options for high-volume senders

text: Build flows from behavior, events, and tags, and check every branch before it runs
quote: Build flows from behavior, events, and tags. Check every branch before it runs.

text: Visual workflows start from a trigger and run steps with branches, delays, and decisions
quote: A Workflow is a visual automation that starts with a trigger and executes a series of steps. Think of it as "when this happens, do that" with the ability to branch, delay, and make decisions.

text: Sequences send a series of emails in order with delays between them
quote: A Sequence is a collection of emails sent in order, with delays between each one.

text: Built-in AI builds what you describe in plain text
quote: Describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you.

text: Migration help offered when switching to Bento
quote: Migration help when you switch

text: Price-match reviews against your current provider's invoice
quote: Price-match reviews with your current invoice

text: Workflow Send webhook action notifies external systems like a CRM, fulfillment tool, or support queue
quote: Use a workflow **Send webhook** action when Bento should notify another system, such as a CRM, fulfillment tool, internal app, or support queue.

text: Webhook payloads can use Liquid variables from person, event, site, or workflow context
quote: Use Liquid variables when the payload needs data from the person, event, site, or workflow context.

text: Official CLI with 50+ commands covering subscribers, CSV import, tags, fields, events, broadcasts, sequences, transactional sends, and templates
quote: The Bento CLI gives you 50+ commands for managing your entire Bento account. Search subscribers, import from CSV, manage tags and fields, track events and purchases, create broadcasts and sequences, send transactional emails, manage templat

text: Bento Skills guides agents on choosing MCP, CLI, SDK, or n8n, with safety guidance for keys and bulk imports
quote: Bento Skills tells the agent when to use Bento MCP, the CLI, an SDK, or n8n. It also carries safety guidance for API keys, bulk subscriber imports, live account operations, and framework-native setup.

text: Ready-made prompts to copy for an AI agent to implement Bento
quote: Copy a ready-made prompt for your AI agent so it can start implementing Bento, fast.

text: n8n is offered as a supported Bento surface alongside MCP, CLI, and SDKs
quote: Pick the right Bento surface for the job: MCP, CLI, SDK, or n8n.

text: Official SDKs for JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, Ruby, PHP, Python, Go, .NET, Rust, Swift, and more
quote: Bento has SDKs for JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, Python, Go, .NET, Rust, Swift, Meteor.js, and Supabase.

text: First-party packages for WordPress, WooCommerce, and Laravel
quote: We maintain first-party packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js.

text: API uses HTTP Basic auth with a publishable key and secret key
quote: Bento uses HTTP Basic authentication. Use your publishable key as the username and your secret key as the password.

text: Postman Collection covers every Bento API endpoint
quote: Our [Postman Collection] covers every Bento API endpoint, so you can call the API directly from any language.

text: API browser lists endpoints with request and response fields and linked docs
quote: This browser gives you one place to scan Bento endpoints, request fields, response fields, and the matching hand-written docs.

text: API troubleshooting guide for diagnosing failed calls by HTTP status and response body
quote: Use this page to diagnose failed API calls. Start with the HTTP status, then inspect the response body and endpoint-specific docs.

text: Run multiple brands or projects as separate Sites with isolated data in one account
quote: Having separate Sites lets you keep data isolated between different projects. Common reasons to use multiple Sites: Multiple brands or products... Production and testing

text: Use a separate testing Site for development and QA, apart from production
quote: Many teams create a production Site for live campaigns and a separate testing Site for development and QA.

text: Transfer a Site between Bento Teams, e.g. an agency handing over a client account
quote: Use this when a Site needs to move from one Bento Team to another, for example when an agency hands a client account over or a business reorganizes its Bento workspace.

text: ClickFunnels integration tracks page views and identifies visitors as subscribers
quote: The Bento ClickFunnels integration adds the Bento tracking script to your funnels so page views are tracked and visitors are identified as subscribers in Bento.

text: Custom segment builder with unlimited conditions and filters
quote: Custom segment builder with unlimited conditions and filters

text: Segments are saved filters that add and remove people automatically and include existing matches without backfill
quote: A Segment is a saved filter that groups people who match specific criteria. When someone meets the criteria, they're automatically included. When they no longer match, they're automatically removed.

text: DNS records authenticate your domain so Bento can send on your behalf
quote: To get your emails delivered reliably, you need to add a few DNS records for your domain. These records authenticate your domain and allow Bento to send email on your behalf.

text: Broadcast API to review history, create campaigns, and schedule sends with explicit audience rules
quote: Broadcasts are one-time marketing sends to a broad audience or a saved segment. Use the API to review broadcast history, create campaigns, and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules.

text: Exclude recipients from an email by listing tags to skip
quote: exclusive_tags (`string`): A comma separated list of tags you do not want the email to go to.

text: Chat API to triage Bento Chat support threads
quote: Use this API to triage Bento Chat support threads with your normal Bento API keys and `site_uuid`.

text: Reusable templates shared across sequences and workflows, with edits propagating everywhere they're used
quote: Reusable: Create once, use in multiple Sequences or Workflows. Consistent: Changes to a template update it everywhere it's used

text: Templates can be plain text or built in a drag-and-drop editor
quote: Templates can be in plain text or built with our drag and drop editor.

text: Form builder creates forms that capture emails and trigger automations on submit
quote: Bento's form builder lets you create customizable forms that capture emails and trigger automations when submitted.

text: Inline, popup, slide-in, and full-page form types, customizable to brand
quote: Inline forms... Popup forms... Slide-in forms... Full-page forms... Each type can be customized to match your brand and conversion goals.

text: API endpoint queues anonymization of a subscriber by email
quote: Use this endpoint to queue anonymization of a visitor (aka a subscriber or user) by email for a specific site.

text: No charge for team seats
quote: Bento does not charge for team seats. Invite your entire team at no extra cost.

text: 30-day free trial, cancel anytime
quote: 30 days free · No seat fees · Cancel anytime

text: $29/month for up to 5,000 active users with unlimited marketing email under fair use
quote: $29 a month for up to 5,000 active users, then from $0.01 per user. Paid plans send unlimited marketing email, subject to fair use.

text: Modular billing: you pay only for features you turn on
quote: Your bill is the sum of whatever you have turned on.
